verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-card spending limits. You can issue cards for specific purposes (travel, software, ads) with a set limit, assign them to responsible people, and adjust VCN ceilings and controls. It also offers cost centers and an 'Área de aprovações' (approvals area). However, cost centers are documented only for classifying expenses, not for allocating budgets, and nothing shows team or project budgets being enforced through card limits or approvals. missing for 10: budget allocation per team/project, budget-to-card-limit enforcement, approval workflows tied to budget thresholds, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
